Too expensive?
Pure cotton lasts 3–4 years. Cheaper than replacing a synthetic shirt every season.
Will the size fit me?
Regular fit — not tight, not loose. Ask which size they usually wear, then take them to the trial room.
Can I wear it to the office?
Yes. Smart casual — wear with formal trousers for work, jeans for the weekend. One shirt, both occasions.
Isn't the colour too dark?
Maroon goes with beige, grey and navy. The check pattern keeps it light — doesn't feel heavy.
Will it shrink after washing?
Cold wash, don't tumble dry. Pure cotton holds its shape well with proper care.
